title: Tony Auth
description: Tony Auth. Pulitzer Prize winning editorial cartoonist for the PHILADELPHIA INQUIRER, has found images in the STAR WARS trilogy for years. It was President Reagan who called the Soviet Union the "Evil Empire" and journalists dubbed his space-based defense plan "Star Wars." The cover of Auth's book, LOST IN SPACE: THE REAGAN YEARS (front), complements his panel (back), "Battling the Dark Side." (Collection of William Plumb.)
